qs.en: The young rooster struts arrogantly in front of the hens in the henhouse.

qs.s: Il se ___ avec sa nouvelle montre de luxe devant ses collègues.
qs.en: He shows off with his new luxury watch in front of his colleagues.

qs.s: Elle se ___ dans sa robe de marque à chaque soirée mondaine.
qs.en: She shows off in her designer dress at every high-society party.
